senses.gloss:
Ocean,Ⓒs.ⒹsamudraH, sAgaraH, siMDuH, udanvAn, arRavaH, ratnAkaraH, akUpAraH, pArAvAraH; and comp. of DiH, niDiH, patiH, rASiH with ‘Water’ q. v.; vArirASiH, jalaniDiH, abDiH, aMbuDiH, vArDiH, apAMpatiH, saritpa-tiH, toyarASiH, aMburASiH, &c.; ‘o(cean)-bound’ sAgarAMta, samudravalaya-rasana-meKala; ‘o(cean) of misery’ duHKa-sAgaraH, vyasanArRavaH.
Ⓝ[Ocean]ic,Ⓒa.ⒹsAmudra (drI f.), samudrIya, (s.) in comp.
